claims.explanation: Monastrol inhibits KIF11/Eg5, causing monopolar spindle arrest and mitotic catastrophe. Sensitivity is likely driven by high expression of KIF11 itself and an intact spindle assembly checkpoint (AURKB, PLK1, MAD2L1, BUB1B, CENPE), which enforces arrest and death, whereas mutations activating PI3K (PIK3CA), Hippo (NF2), or LKB1 (STK11) pathways may allow cells to survive by escaping or resisting mitotic arrest. RB1 loss and other cell-cycle mutations (CTNNB1, KMT2C) may further sensitize by deregulating proliferation.
